run_racecar_zed_simulation: run the RacecarZEDGymEnv with a loaded deepq model to simulate autonomous racecar driving
create_racecar_zed_env: create a RacecarZEDGymEnv instance with rendering enabled for visualizing the racecar simulation
load_deepq_model: load a trained deepq policy from a pickle file to act as the racecar agent
run_episode_loop: run an episode loop that resets the environment, steps through actions, and accumulates rewards
render_racecar_env: render the current frame of the racecar ZED gym environment during simulation
